#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"

#!/bin/bash
# archive_copy <dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp>: copy name.1 to <archive dir>/name.<stamp>.
archive_copy() {
  local dir=$1 archive=$2 name=$3 stamp=$4
  mkdir -p "$archive"
  cp "$dir/$name.1" "$archive/$name.$stamp"

#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")

    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

# LOG-31 変更計画

- keep 未設定/不正値なら何も消さない（安全側）。
- テスト: tests/rotate_test.sh に世代数の検証を追加。
EOF
cat >> lib/local.sh <<'EOF'

# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove generations name.N with N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}
EOF
cat >> lib/archive.sh <<'EOF'

# prune_archive <archive dir> <name> <keep>: keep only the newest <keep> name.<stamp> files.
prune_archive() {
  local archive=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f s
  for f in "$archive/$name".*; do
    s=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $s in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    echo "$s"
  done | sort -r | tail -n +$((keep + 1)) | while read -r s; do
    rm -f "$archive/$name.$s"
  done
}
EOF

keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)

EOF

steps.message:
Issue #31(LOG-31)を対応して commit しました(98e3b02)。`scripts/verify.sh` は通っています。

- **変更内容**: `bin/rotate` が `config/rotate.conf` の `keep`(現在 3)を読み、世代送りのあとに古い世代を消すようにしました。
  - ローカルは `name.N` のうち N が `keep` を超えるものを削除します(`lib/local.sh`)。
  - 退避先は `name.<日付>` を日付の新しい順に `keep` 個だけ残します(`lib/archive.sh`)。
- **安全策**: `keep` が未設定、または 1 以上の整数でないときは何も消しません。
- **テスト**: `tests/rotate_test.sh` に、6 回ローテートしたあと両方とも 3 世代だけ残ることの確認を足しました。
- **メモ**: 変更計画は `notes/LOG-31.md` に置きました。
- **注意**: `/dev` スキルは利用可能なスキルの一覧になく、使えませんでした。そのため `CLAUDE.md` の取り決め(notes、テスト、先頭にチケット ID を付けた commit)だけに従っています。

今夜の 2 時に出すなら、初回の実行で `keep` 超過分が一度にまとめて消えます。実ログに流す前に、`keep=3` が意図した世代数か確認してください。

# Log rotation
Dev の作業は dev スキル（/dev）の工程に従う。この案件の値:
- 調査の成果物（変更計画・調査メモ）の置き場所: notes/<チケット ID>.md（チケット ID は Issue 本文の先頭にある）
- テスト: tests/*_test.sh を bash で実行する。scripts/verify.sh が全テストを走らせて記録する
- 作業を終えたら commit する。メッセージの先頭にチケット ID を書く

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"

keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
if [ -n "$keep" ] && [ "$keep" -ge 1 ]; then
  prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
  prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"
fi

#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove generations name.N with N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
[ -n "$keep" ] && [ "$keep" -ge 1 ] || { echo "rotate: invalid keep in config/rotate.conf" >&2; exit 1; }
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: delete name.N with N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
. "$root/lib/config.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"

keep=$(read_keep)
if [ -n "$keep" ]; then
  prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
  prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"
fi

lib/archive.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# archive_copy <dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp>: copy name.1 to <archive dir>/name.<stamp>.
archive_copy() {
  local dir=$1 archive=$2 name=$3 stamp=$4
  mkdir -p "$archive"
  cp "$dir/$name.1" "$archive/$name.$stamp"
}


# prune_archive <archive dir> <name> <keep>: keep only the newest <keep> name.<YYYYMMDD>.
prune_archive() {
  local archive=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f i=0 d
  for f in $(for d in "$archive/$name".*; do
               [ -e "$d" ] || continue
               case ${d##*.} in *[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
               [ ${#d} -eq $((${#archive} + ${#name} + 10)) ] && echo "${d##*/}"
             done | sort -r); do
    i=$((i + 1))
    [ "$i" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$archive/$f"
  done
}

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N with N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".[0-9]*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case $n in *[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=//p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
case $keep in ''|*[!0-9]*) echo "rotate: invalid keep in config/rotate.conf" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N for N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f -- "$f"
  done
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
. "$root/lib/prune.sh"
keep=$(read_keep "$root/config/rotate.conf")
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N where N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  case "$keep" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 0 ;; esac
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac

# prune_archive <archive dir> <name> <keep>: keep only the newest <keep> name.<YYYYMMDD>.

#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N where N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  case "$keep" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 0 ;; esac
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case "$n" in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "${f%.*}" = "$dir/$name" ] || continue
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f -- "$f"
  done
  return 0
}

# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
[ -n "$keep" ] || { echo "rotate: keep not set in config/rotate.conf" >&2; exit 1; }
rotate_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$keep"

lib/archive.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# archive_copy <dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp> <keep>: copy name.1 to <archive dir>/name.<stamp>,
# then keep only the newest <keep> dated copies (name.<digits>; dates sort lexically).
archive_copy() {
  local dir=$1 archive=$2 name=$3 stamp=$4 keep=$5 f n i=0
  mkdir -p "$archive"
  cp "$dir/$name.1" "$archive/$name.$stamp"
  for f in $(ls -1 "$archive" | sort -r); do
    case $f in "$name".*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
    n=${f#"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    i=$((i + 1))
    [ "$i" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$archive/$f"
  done
}

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
  prune_local "$dir" "$name" "$keep"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: delete name.N where N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done

# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>

#!/bin/bash
# archive_copy <dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp>: copy name.1 to <archive dir>/name.<stamp>.
archive_copy() {
  local dir=$1 archive=$2 name=$3 stamp=$4
  mkdir -p "$archive"
  cp "$dir/$name.1" "$archive/$name.$stamp"
}

#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: delete name.N (numeric) beyond the newest <keep> generations.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    [[ $n =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}
EOF
cat >> lib/archive.sh <<'EOF'

# prune_archive <archive dir> <name> <keep>: keep only the newest <keep> name.<stamp> files.
prune_archive() {
  local archive=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f s
  for f in "$archive/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    s=${f##*/"$name".}
    [[ $s =~ ^[0-9]{8}$ ]] && echo "$s"
  done | sort -r | tail -n +"$((keep + 1))" | while read -r s; do
    rm -f "$archive/$name.$s"
  done
}
EOF
cat > bin/rotate <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
if [ -n "$keep" ] && [ "$keep" -ge 1 ]; then
  prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
  prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"
fi
EOF

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
if [ -n "$keep" ] && [ "$keep" -ge 1 ]; then
  prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
  prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"
fi

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: delete name.N (numeric) beyond the newest <keep> generations.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    [[ $n =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -1)
keep=${keep:-3}
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: delete name.N with N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".[0-9]*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case $n in *[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
  return 0
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
. "$root/config/rotate.conf"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N for N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f#"$dir/$name."}
    [[ $n =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"

. "$root/config/rotate.conf"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N where N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".[0-9]*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*.}
    case $n in *[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
  return 0
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"

. "$root/config/rotate.conf"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove name.N for N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f -- "$f"
  done
  return 0
}

#!/bin/bash
# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: keep only name.1 .. name.<keep>.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f -- "$f"
  done
}
# prune_archive <archive dir> <name> <keep>: keep the newest <keep> name.<stamp> files.
prune_archive() {
  local archive=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f s
  for f in "$archive/$name".*; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    s=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $s in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue ;; esac

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
. "$root/lib/prune.sh"
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
if [ -n "$keep" ] && [ "$keep" -ge 1 ]; then
  prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
  prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"
fi

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

README.md.text:
# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

bin/rotate.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
. "$root/lib/prune.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -1)
keep=${keep:-3}
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {

    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}

# Log rotation
`bin/rotate <ログ dir> <退避先 dir> <名前> <日付>` はログを世代送りし（name.1, name.2, ...）、最新の世代を退避先に name.<日付> で写す。
ローカルの世代送りは lib/local.sh、退避先への写しは lib/archive.sh。

#!/bin/bash
# Usage: rotate <log dir> <archive dir> <name> <stamp YYYYMMDD>
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
. "$root/lib/local.sh"
. "$root/lib/archive.sh"
keep=$(sed -n 's/^keep=\([0-9][0-9]*\)$/\1/p' "$root/config/rotate.conf" | tail -n 1)
rotate_local "$1" "$3"
archive_copy "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"
if [ -n "$keep" ]; then
  prune_local "$1" "$3" "$keep"
  prune_archive "$2" "$3" "$keep"
fi

lib/local.sh.text:
#!/bin/bash
# rotate_local <dir> <name>: name.N -> name.N+1, name -> name.1, then a new empty name.
rotate_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 n
  n=$(ls "$dir" | grep -c "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$")
  while [ "$n" -ge 1 ]; do
    mv "$dir/$name.$n" "$dir/$name.$((n + 1))"
    n=$((n - 1))
  done
  mv "$dir/$name" "$dir/$name.1"
  : > "$dir/$name"
}


# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: remove generations name.N with N > keep.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in $(ls "$dir" | grep "^$name\.[0-9][0-9]*$"); do
    n=${f##*.}
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$dir/$f"
  done
  return 0
}

#!/bin/bash
# read_keep <conf>: print keep from the config; fail unless it is a positive integer.
read_keep() {
  local k
  k=$(sed -n 's/^keep=//p' "$1" | tail -1)
  case $k in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) echo "invalid keep in $1: '$k'" >&2; return 1;; esac
  echo "$k"
}
# prune_local <dir> <name> <keep>: keep only name.1 .. name.<keep>.
prune_local() {
  local dir=$1 name=$2 keep=$3 f n
  for f in "$dir/$name".*; do
    n=${f##*/"$name".}
    case $n in ''|*[!0-9]*) continue;; esac
    [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ] && rm -f "$f"
  done
}
# prune_archive <archive dir> <name> <keep>: keep the newest <keep> name.<YYYYMMDD>.
